task.description:
Implement EXP-102: Wire src/expr into transition.zig for gateway condition evaluation; retire vendor/cel from production paths.

## Step 0 — git-setup
```bash
git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
git checkout -b feature/WF02-exp102-expr-cutover-20260612
```

## Pre-condition: run differential corpus
```bash
zig build test 2>&1 | grep -i 'differential\|TC-ISS-602'
```
If any differential divergence: fix src/expr to match CEL semantics before proceeding.

## Implementation per design doc
1. In `src/engine/transition.zig`: replace `cel.evaluate(condition, context)` call with the `src/expr` equivalent as specified in the design.
2. Update the import: replace `const cel = @import("cel")` with the src/expr import (check build.zig for the module name).
3. Add a compile-time comment to vendor/cel: `// REFERENCE ONLY — do not add new callers; see EXP-102`.
4. Ensure no other production module (non-test) imports vendor/cel.
5. Transition function must remain I/O-free (no allocations that escape, no network/disk).

## Validation
```
zig build
zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set'  # must be empty
zig build test
```

## Acceptance criteria check before commit
- grep for cel imports in src/ (excluding tests/differential): must return only vendor/cel itself and any adapter file
- Differential test still passes (corpus green)
- Transition function I/O-free (no I/O-related imports added)

## Commit
```bash
git add -A
git commit -m 'feat(exp102): wire src/expr into transition.zig; retire vendor/cel from production paths'
git push origin feature/WF02-exp102-expr-cutover-20260612
```
acceptance_criteria: transition.zig uses src/expr for gateway condition evaluation
vendor/cel no longer called in production paths
